The '''Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill''' was a bill in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] that was opposed by many [[Senator/Legends|senators]], including [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].
